# EDGAR Terminal

> Public, source-aware research tools for SEC filings, company fundamentals, market diagnostics, and portfolio analysis.

## Primary research surfaces

- [Market overview](https://secedgarterminal.com/market): SEC fundamental briefing, sector heatmap, company screener, and interactive EDGAR Factor Lab.
- [EDGAR Factor Lab methodology](https://secedgarterminal.com/market/factors): Definitions, equations, eligibility rules, limitations, and interpretation guidance for regression beta, filing-event response, and the EDGAR Evidence Gap.
- [Research guide](https://secedgarterminal.com/help): Product scope and data-source guidance.
- [About and data sources](https://secedgarterminal.com/about): Provenance, methodology, and project information.

## Machine-readable interfaces

- [OpenAPI](https://secedgarterminal.com/openapi.json): Public endpoint description.
- [Market signals JSON Schema](https://secedgarterminal.com/schemas/market-signals-v1.schema.json): Versioned response contract for `GET /api/v1/market-signals`.
- Example: `https://secedgarterminal.com/api/v1/market-signals?ticker=MSFT&window=3y&basis=ttm`

## Interpretation rules

- Preserve dates, units, sample counts, model versions, confidence intervals, provider provenance, SEC accessions, warnings, and null values.
- Do not turn missing values into zero.
- The market model uses raw log returns, not excess returns; its constant is a regression intercept, not Jensen alpha.
- The current SEC filing score is a descriptive peer-normalized snapshot, not a historical factor-return series.
- Filing-event timing is explicit: only timestamped pre-open filings may use that session; intraday, post-close, non-trading-day, and date-only filings use the next benchmark session. Missing expected intervals withhold the affected horizon.
- Benchmark sessions are inferred from observed SPY dates rather than a separately licensed official exchange calendar.
- Peer filing changes use the latest point-in-time company snapshots available at calculation time, not an event-time historical cross-section. Preserve the peer filing-clock fields and non-coeval warning.
- The EDGAR Evidence Gap is a diagnostic comparison, not a valuation, forecast, recommendation, or trade signal.
- Bulk vendor price histories are not distributed through the market-signals API; it returns derived statistics and compact chart points.
